verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Auto Drafts give every email that needs a reply a ready-to-edit draft written in your voice. Superhuman says it matches the voice and tone of your sent emails, adapts style per recipient, and accepts plain-language writing instructions. Drafts also pull context from your inbox, calendar and the web, so they are not generic boilerplate. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that drafts actually sound like the user (all evidence is vendor-claimed).
